notablePrerequisites: You've cast your commander from the command zone at least twice this game.
description:
Activate Thunderclap Drake by paying {2}{U} and sacrificing it.
Cast Three Steps Ahead by paying {U} plus an additional {2} due to Thunderclap Drake to select its second mode, targeting Biovisionary.
Thunderclap Drake triggers, copying Three Steps Ahead at least twice, with all copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Three Steps Ahead spells, creating at least three copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers, causing you to win the game.
